lifecycle_note: Confirmed. geminicli.com memory docs banner: 'Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI on June 18th, 2026' for unpaid-tier and Google One users. Google Developers Blog (2026-05-19) says Google 'will continue to support Gemini CLI' for Code Assist Standard/Enterprise and paid API keys. Repo README (2026-10) says Gemini CLI is maintained for enterprise Code Assist workflows and is not tuned for Gemini 4. Not deprecated overall, so lifecycle stays active; desc already carries the 2026-06-18 change. Side note: the memory docs no longer mention a save_memory tool; the agent edits GEMINI.md with write_file/replace (the row name still says save_memory).

updates.old: Google's open-source Gemini CLI persists facts by editing tiered Markdown memory files — repo GEMINI.md, a per-project private memory folder and global ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md — that load into hierarchical context each session. Traction: Google first-party; Gemini CLI is one of the most-used terminal coding agents. On 2026-06-18 Google replaced Gemini CLI with Antigravity CLI for free, Google One and Google AI Pro/Ultra users; Gemini CLI stays supported for Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise licenses and paid Gemini or Agent Platform API keys.
